GRIEVANCE XVI ◆ THE WORLD BEYOND

He has allowed a besieged ally’s vital communications to become an instrument of coercion and uncertainty.

THE RECORD SHOWS

Ukraine reported restrictions to military Starshield service that hampered drone operations; reports disagree about whether the order came from the White House or Elon Musk.

Reuters, citing officials, reported an instruction from inside the White House; The Wall Street Journal, as summarized by Reuters, reported that Musk ordered the slowdown. Trump and Musk disputed responsibility. The restriction and its operational effects are reported, but personal responsibility remains contested; this grievance does not claim that all Starlink satellites were shut off.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. October 15, 2026Reuters reported that a limit on Ukrainian Starshield service had been authorized from inside the White House.
  2. October 16, 2026Trump publicly denied that either he or Musk was responsible for the disruption.
  3. October 20, 2026Reuters relayed a Wall Street Journal account attributing the slowdown to Musk, leaving the origin contested.

WHAT THE RECORD DOES NOT ESTABLISH

The evidence concerns reduced availability and speed of specific military communications, not a total outage of all satellites serving Ukraine. The parties dispute who directed the limits.
